name: The Hollow Crown
notes: Hand-made expedition map (tools/make_hollowcrown.py; the format is described there). A raised core (the Crown, its Throne and two boss Gaols), a ring of four regions each with one plateau reached by stairs, and four quiet outer isles with the exits. Nothing is placed by dice except what the match rolls: which spawn points, lairs and camps are live, loot, the Blight, weather.

regions.name: The Crown
regions.purpose: The vault on the Throne, two boss Gaols and the richest chests, under the most Blight.

regions.name: Frostgate
regions.purpose: The best armor on the map, the Keep's high ground over the Gate Span, an uplink outpost on the south edge.

regions.name: Cinder Steps
regions.purpose: Forge country: gloves and weapon tunings from the Kilns, a camp to level on, an uplink outpost on the east rim.

regions.name: Stormbreak
regions.purpose: The shrine on the Shrine Table, boots, and Storm Halt (sky train) off its east rim.

regions.name: Thornwood
regions.purpose: The Boki nest and the Thornhive lair; tall-grass ambushes.

regions.name: Larkhollow
regions.purpose: Wild Boki graze in the Hollow; a calm place to catch one.

regions.name: Highwatch
regions.purpose: The Lookout over the Gaol and the Watch Road, and boots.

regions.name: Duskmoor
regions.purpose: Relics in the Moor Chapel ruins.

regions.name: Saltmere
regions.purpose: Salt caches along the dry river, the outer ring's most chests.
